title: Logos 9 opening: consubstantial with the Father (with texts)
english: Ninth discourse. That the Son is consubstantial with the Father, with texts set beside the argument.
Homoousios is defended from Scripture’s own naming, not as a bare slogan.
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Condensed lemma-led tip.
No Greystone wording. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
